purpose: Bounded own-prefix adaptation comparison; not detector qualification or general COCO quality certification

preprocessing.geometry: full-image stretch; no padding or cropping

selection.rule: ascending COCO image id; COCO license4 CC BY2; 1..12 boxes; no crowd; all boxes finite/positive/in image; current Flickr CC BY2 and creator available
selection.splitAssignment: first four selected ids train; next two tuning; final four evaluation
